units.rawText: My neural cloud often replays video data from the past. The people there all look cruel, ugly, and seem to be laughing at me…
units.displayText: My neural cloud often replays video data from the past. The people there all look cruel, ugly, and seem to be laughing at me…

spans.text: My neural cloud often replays video data from the past. The people there all look cruel, ugly, and seem to be laughing at me…

units.rawText: Is this the punishment I deserve? All I can do is bear it and carry on—It cannot be washed away or made up for, not even in death.
units.displayText: Is this the punishment I deserve? All I can do is bear it and carry on—It cannot be washed away or made up for, not even in death.

spans.text: Is this the punishment I deserve? All I can do is bear it and carry on—It cannot be washed away or made up for, not even in death.

units.rawText: From reality to the cloud server, from the moment I wake until the moment I sleep, all I can do is ruminate on my past sins until someone else comes to absolve me…

units.rawText: Will you be my savior, Professor?
